name: admin
description: Administration console for users, sessions, roles and audit, on top of the auth and audit extensions

authoring.description: The administration console is part of the application, while auth keeps ownership of permissions, freshness checks, lifecycle hooks and transactional account operations, and audit keeps the log. Customize the console copy and screens before replacing behavior.

surfaces.name: administration copy
surfaces.description: Change console wording through the admin.* keys of the UI catalogue.

surfaces.name: administration screens
surfaces.description: Override one admin/* screen when its structure must change; keep permissions and mutation behavior package-owned.

surfaces.name: account lifecycle
surfaces.description: Role, registration and account-status hooks are auth's: they fire for the console and every other caller.

agent.description: Local, revision-pinned references for agents configuring the admin extension.

references.name: admin extension guide
references.description: Configuration and operational guidance for users, sessions and roles.
